> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR

> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, `packages/qa/scenarios/package.json`, `packages/qa/scenarios/vitest.config.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9c1edbcd20417a91f44162978518da27f61931c0` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `16d393e652a5af7c7005966a893c62420d9d03e2` — the merge of head `142d4d7b854ad4164531a9411825285e066c1d13` into base `9c1edbcd20417a91f44162978518da27f61931c0`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 16d393e652a5af7c7005966a893c62420d9d03e2 && git checkout 16d393e652a5af7c7005966a893c62420d9d03e2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9c1edbcd20417a91f44162978518da27f61931c0 142d4d7b854ad4164531a9411825285e066c1d13 && git checkout -B drift-repro 9c1edbcd20417a91f44162978518da27f61931c0 && git merge --no-ff 142d4d7b854ad4164531a9411825285e066c1d13

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9c1edbcd20417a91f44162978518da27f61931c0
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9c1edbcd20417a91f44162978518da27f61931c0` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:devx#3 · `Head-sha: 37d8ec1cd013fda34e4fe099be746411e8b48472` · 2026-11-07T07:29Z

Reviewed against GitHub at the head above, not against the report's own account.

- **Shape:** draft, base `main`, line 1 `Fixes #30984`. A closing-keyword scan of the whole body finds no other card number.
- **Premise, measured:** at origin/main `719a502b`, each of the seven tag strings appeared 0 times in `scenario-tags.ts` (positive control `records-forms`: 4). The PR adds seven rows to the closed table, each with pass/fail discrimination fixtures. A library test over `docs/qa/scenarios/` proves each tag is scored, never `unscored`, on every card that declares it.
- **File surface:** `GET /pulls/31098/files` lists 7 paths. Four fall inside the claim (6703120449): `scenario-tags.ts`, the new helper `scenario-expressions.ts` beside it, the test, and the README rows. Three are outside it, accepted as declared minimal deviations: `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`, which declare `@objectstack/formula` (a workspace package already in the `./score/full` runtime graph through objectql and plugin-sharing), and `vitest.config.ts`, one anchored source alias that `check:test-source-alias` requires. The PR touches 0 paths in `schema.ts`, `loader.ts`, the cards or `src/runner/**`. `check-governed-merges --pr 31098`: NOT governed, 854 changed lines, ≤ 3000.
- **Entry boundary held:** `scenario-tags.ts` is re-exported only by `src/score/index.ts` (`./score/full`). The narrow `./score` entry (`narrow.ts`) excludes the capability-tag checks by its own header, so the new `@objectstack/formula` import does not reach it.
- **Rulings held:** "Deterministic: no model call, no network" is restated in the helper's header, and the helper calls only `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/spec` functions. "⛔ Never a prefix or area match": every row is keyed by its full tag.
- **Spot reads:** each verdict is the platform's own function at that site. Formulas and predicates go through `validateExpression` at `record` scope over the declared columns plus `resolveInjectedSystemColumns`. Approver expressions go through `collectCelRootIdentifiers` over `APPROVER_EXPRESSION_ROOTS`. RLS `using` goes through `isSupportedRlsExpression`.
- **Accepted deviations:**
  - (1) The card's suggested checks are sharpened by measurement, with the reasons in the PR body. A stored field with an `expression` counts as a formula field. A validation rule must be active with `severity: 'error'`. The RLS row requires that the policy is enforced. `manager` counts as dynamic routing. "Report" means a `reports` item.
  - (2) Named gap: "compiles" is the shared validator's verdict. The build's further site rules are not re-run, and `scenario-expressions.ts` says so.
  - (3) The PR has no assignee. The dev followed AGENTS.md and the `pr_create` op header over the os-dev.md line. The seat assigns at hand-over if one is owed; none is owed for a non-governed landing.
- **Gates (check-runs at this head, read 2026-11-07T07:29Z):** 19 success, 12 skipped, 34 still running, 0 failure. Landing waits for every check to be green or an expected skip. Local: 62 of 62 derived families exited 0; package tests 402/402; four ablations each turned red and were restored.
- **Out of scope:** two `noted, not filed` items are read inferences with no measured run, outside classes a/b/c. One: five cards tag `dashboards.report` while naming the report under `expect.dashboards`. The other: `ai.agent-actions` double-weights a missing action. Both are recorded here as candidates for the epic seat's next live run.
- **Landing:** when every check is green, the seat sends `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay. `mcp_calls` 0.
